hero.title: File:Kgosi Leruo Tshedkedi Molotlegi.jpg
hero.artist: U.S. Department of State from United States
hero.description: U.S. Embassy Pretoria Press Attache Sharon Hudson-Dean poses for a photo with King of the Royal Bafokeng Nation, Kgosi Leruo Tshekedi Molotlegi, and a fellow U.S. Embassy Pretoria staff member before two Under-11 Bafokeng Football Academy teams previewed the FIFA 2010 World Cup match between the United States and Ghana by playing each other as the “U.S.” and Ghana” on June 25, 2010, in Rustenburg, South Africa. The game highlighted the development of rural soccer in South Africa, particularly in the Royal Bafokeng Nation, which consists of twenty-nine villages located in the Rustenburg Valley in the North West Province. [State Department photo/ Public Domain]

gallery.title: File:Maggie Laubser 1945.jpg
gallery.description: This portrait of Maggie Laubser was taken in 1945, while she was busy readying a painting of a daughter of the Bafokeng people. The painting, 'Annie of the Royal Bafokeng' is signed 'M. Laubser' (lower right) and further signed, inscribed, and dated 'Maggie Laubser, Oortmanspoort, Klipheuvel Stasie, Kaap 1945'.
